description:
*🤝 Inter-Club Meet & Greet and Flag Exchange Ceremony 🤝*
*Rotary Club of Skycity Borivli Meets Rotary Family of Anand*

*Venue: BVM College, Anand | Time: 12:30 PM to 2:30 PM*

A memorable moment of fellowship and collaboration!

Rotary Club of Skycity Borivli had a wonderful *Meet & Greet with Rotary Club of Anand and surrounding clubs*, hosted in presence of *PDG Rtn. Nihir Dave - District 3060.*

Participating Clubs:
*Rotary Club of Anand, Rotary Club of Anand River Town, Rotary Club of Anand Multicity* and other clubs of Anand.

With warm presence of:
*Rtn. Anant Patel*
*Rtn. Dr. Mamta Lumbu - President, Rotary Club of Anand*

It was a fruitful interaction with exchange of ideas, projects, and thoughts on togetherness. We discussed different types of collaborations and possibilities of doing joint projects in future.

The meeting was marked by a traditional *Flag Exchange* ceremony, symbolizing friendship and bonding between clubs.

Representing Rotary Club of Skycity Borivli:
*Rtn. Rajesh Sahu - President*
*Rtn. Sameer Choudhary - Secretary*
*Rtn. Samir Shrimankar - Treasurer*
Along with Board of Directors and Members.

The fellowship concluded with a delicious lunch hosted with great warmth.

*Fellowship Beyond Boundaries. Service above Self and beyond boundaries.

*Rotary Club of Skycity Borivli*
